description.zh: 佐渡岛金银山曾是江户时代世界上最大的金矿，于17世纪鼎盛期支撑了整个江户幕府的财政。遗址完整保存了从手工选矿到近代工业采矿的各阶段技术，于2024年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Sado Island's gold and silver mines were the world's largest gold mine during the Edo period, their 17th-century peak output underwriting the entire shogunate's finances. The surviving site documents the full transition from hand-mining to modern industrial extraction. UNESCO-listed in 2024.

zh: 西三川砂金山：日本最古老的金矿，可体验砂金淘洗
相川金银山：江户幕府直辖矿山，坑道内有蜡像还原当年采矿场景
北泽浮游选矿场：明治大正时代建造的工业化选矿遗址
en: Nishimikawa: Japan's oldest gold mine; visitors can try gold panning
Aikawa gold and silver mine: Edo shogunate's direct-managed mine with wax-figure dioramas inside the tunnels
Kitazawa Flotation Plant: Meiji–Taisho era industrial ore processing ruins

admission.zh: 相川矿山坑道参观约900日元；西三川砂金山约1,000日元
admission.en: Aikawa mine shaft tour ~¥900; Nishimikawa gold panning ~¥1,000

duration.zh: 一天（建议包含渡轮时间在行程内）
duration.en: Full day (factor in ferry crossing time)

tips.zh: 从新潟港乘高速船约65分钟或乘渡轮约2.5小时到佐渡。岛上景点分散，建议租车或参加当地观光巴士。
tips.en: From Niigata port: 65-minute jetfoil or 2.5-hour ferry to Sado. Sites are spread across the island — rent a car or join a local sightseeing bus.

description.zh: 系鱼川地质公园位于新潟县，以世界上最古老的翡翠产地（约5亿年前）而举世闻名，同时也是糸鱼川—静冈构造线（日本列岛东西地质分界线）的北端，地质多样性极为丰富。
description.en: The Itoigawa Geopark in Niigata Prefecture is world-renowned as the oldest known source of jade (approximately 500 million years old) and marks the northern terminus of the Itoigawa-Shizuoka Tectonic Line — the geological boundary dividing eastern and western Japan.

zh: 翡翠峡谷（小滝川硬玉峡）：世界上最古老的翡翠产地之一
系鱼川市フォッサマグナミュージアム：展示日本列岛地质与翡翠文化
日本海沿岸的翡翠海滩，运气好可捡到天然翡翠原石
en: Kotaki River jade gorge: one of the world's oldest known jade source areas
Fossa Magna Museum: exhibits on the geology of the Japanese archipelago and jade culture
Japan Sea coastal beaches where lucky visitors occasionally find natural jade pebbles

admission.zh: フォッサマグナミュージアム540日元

tips.zh: 从北陆新干线糸鱼川站步行或骑车可到达大多数景点。翡翠原石拾取必须在指定海滩（不可进入天然记念物指定区域）。
tips.en: Most attractions are walkable or cyclable from Itoigawa Shinkansen station. Jade pebble searching is only permitted on designated beaches, not inside protected natural monument zones.

description.zh: 越后妻有大地艺术祭（Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale）是全球规模最大的户外艺术节，在新潟县南部约760平方公里的里山田园风光中散布着350余件常设与临时艺术装置。北川富朗主导的这一项目以艺术重新激活了老龄化的农村社区，每届三年举办，常设展区全年开放（部分冬季关闭）。
description.en: The Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennale is the world's largest outdoor art festival, with 350+ permanent and temporary installations scattered across ~760 km² of satoyama (rural mountain) landscape in southern Niigata. Directed by Fram Kitagawa, the project revitalises ageing agricultural villages through art; the triennial event runs every three years, with permanent works accessible year-round (partial winter closures).

location.zh: 新潟县十日町市·津南町周边
location.en: Tokamachi City and Tsunan Town area, Niigata Prefecture

zh: 清津峡隧道（Tunnel of Light）：渓谷道内的光影镜面装置，是世界最被广泛拍摄的艺术作品之一
农舞台：原小学改造的艺术设施，周边梯田艺术装置令人印象深刻
里山里海：以饱含生活气息的日本农村景观为背景，骑行或驾车串联各处装置艺术
en: Tunnel of Light, Kiyotsu Gorge: a mirrored-light installation inside a river-canyon tunnel — one of the world's most-photographed artworks
Nohbutai (Agricultural Stage): former school converted into an art facility surrounded by terrace-field installations
Satoyama landscape: explore by bicycle or car through rice-paddy countryside to connect the scattered artworks

admission.zh: 常设展区单独购票约1,500日元；三年祭期间护照票约4,000日元
admission.en: Permanent sites individual tickets ~¥1,500; triennale passport ~¥4,000

tips.zh: 基地设在十日町站，需租车或参加特定旅游班车游览（公共交通不便利）。清津峡须事先在线预约参观时段（名额有限）。三年祭期间（2022、2025…）装置数量大幅增加，体验更丰富。
tips.en: Base yourself at Tokamachi station; rent a car or join shuttle tours (public transport is inadequate for full coverage). Kiyotsu Gorge requires online advance reservation. Triennale years (2022, 2025…) dramatically expand the number of installations.
